name: search-email-invoices
description: Find Gmail bills, invoices, and receipts and show an interactive checklist. Saving is provided by the separate save-invoices plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Find Gmail bills, invoices, and receipts and show an interactive checklist.
interface.longDescription: Searches your connected Gmail account for bills, invoices and receipts across keyword, attachment, label and forwarded-mail passes, and shows an interactive checklist to select from. Saving is provided by the separate Save Invoices plugin.
defaultPrompt: Find my bills and receipts from the last 3 months.
